note: StepDestroyInfra set NonFatal=true; orchestrator now continues through remote-iso / cleanup / firewall even on TF destroy failure; OnError message updated to reflect new semantics.
destroyWithPlan now returns plan error instead of silently falling back to destroyDirect; operator must explicitly pass UsePlan=false to bypass the plan step.
--dry-run flag landed on deploy, destroy, and update-ingress per roadmap M3; destroy dry-run runs tf Init + PlanStreamed with destroy=true; exits 2 via errtypes.ConfigError on plan failure.

Old 'file cleanup will be skipped unless --force is used' removed; replaced with accurate 'continuing with file/firewall cleanup (re-run okdctl destroy to retry infrastructure)' now that StepDestroyInfra is NonFatal.

schemaVersion field added to Config; loader rejects missing or mismatched schemaVersion values with a clear error pointing at SchemaVersionV1; DefaultConfig/MinimalConfig auto-inject the current version.
yaml.Unmarshal swapped for yaml.UnmarshalStrict; unknown top-level keys now error out at load time instead of being silently dropped.

Air-gap workstream (M21-M27, M33) fully reverted; no airgap plan/bundle code left in tree, so any follow-on state/recovery concerns scoped to that workstream are moot. State-and-recovery audit never had open airgap rows, so this is a clarifying note rather than a row deletion.
